release_note.behavior: Randomized Prim uses explicit frontier wall/target edges, shared PCG32 bounded selection, swap-pop removal, and exact unique-edge accounting while preserving seeded raster goldens.
release_note.api: byul_maze_generate_randomized_prim adds replayable seed, cancellation, max_steps, max_cells, status, and failure-atomic output controls.
release_note.claim_boundary: The API promises randomized frontier growth and a perfect Maze, not minimum-weight or uniform-spanning-tree sampling.
release_note.compatibility: maze_maze_prim remains exported as a deprecated ABI 1.x typo forwarder. Equal checked seeds preserve the pre-API raster order.
